prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, redesign] Full Bleed Companion Launch Welcome Layout: Replaces the home_intro welcome layout with an immersive full-bleed presentation showing the companion ready on the desktop workspace.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Your Companion Has Arrived!", "body": "Your new desktop companion is fully set up and ready to join your desktop."}}
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Interactive Story Scroll Intro Stage: Adds a story scroll intro screen before path selection featuring interactive previews of companion behaviors.
   config: {"new_story_scroll_intro": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop World", "body": "Explore companion possibilities before choosing how you want to bring yours to life.", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful"}]}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Compact Photo Selection Grid Layout: Redesigns the photo upload screen into a compact grid layout with immediate preview components.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "compact", "components": [{"type": "preview", "style": "rounded"}]}}
3: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Activation Action Spotlight View: Introduces a spotlight component focus on the final welcome screen highlighting the exact desktop spawn button.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Launch Your Pet Onto Desktop", "body": "Click the button below to bring your companion directly onto your screen background.", "button_label": "Spawn Desktop Pet"}}
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Environment Setup Progress Checklist: Adds a real-time environment checklist to the waiting screen displaying key background rendering milestones.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Preparing desktop environment", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
5: [sign_in, layout] Compact Split Authentication View: Reconfigures the sign_in screen to use a split layout separating quick guest continuation from cloud account login.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Connect Your Account", "body": "Sign in to keep your pet saved safely in the cloud across app sessions."}}
6: [choose_path, copy] Minimalist Path Selection Headline Copy: Simplifies the headline and body text on the path selection screen to communicate quick setup speed.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Select Your Adoption Path", "body": "Choose preset fast-track or build a custom pet in just a few quick steps."}}
7: [adoption, hint] Photo Framing Assistant Hint Component: Adds a clear framing guidance text hint component on the photo upload view.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use well-lit, centered front-facing photos for optimal pet generation results.", "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Pro tip: Clear lighting gives best custom pet details!", "style": "subtle"}]}}
8: [home, notification] Desktop Launch Ready Sound Cue Switch: Enables an optional audio cue toggle component on the waiting screen when background generation completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "sound", "label": "Play audio chime when companion ready", "action": "play"}]}}
9: [sign_in, hint] Account Session Reset Safeguard Hint: Adds explicit hint copy on the sign_in screen explaining that logging into an existing account recovers existing pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing into an existing account restores your existing desktop companions automatically."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the home_intro layout inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding a new interactive story screen before choose_path inside onboarding is permitted.
Redesigning the photo upload screen into a compact grid layout retains its core functionality.
Updating home_intro with a spotlight view and button label is allowed within onboarding.
Adding a setup progress checklist component to the waiting screen is permitted.
Reconfiguring the sign_in screen to a split layout preserves authentication functionality.
Updating headline and body copy on choose_path preserves both adoption paths without mentioning pricing.
Adding a framing guidance hint component to the upload_photos screen is allowed.
Adding a sound cue toggle to the waiting screen is a valid component update.
Adding account restoration hint copy to the sign_in screen is allowed.
